settings.heading: How your TOOSA gets to you.
settings.lead: Local delivery in the Lower Mainland, shipping across Canada, free pickup in Richmond, and what happens if something isn't right.

settings.title: Lower Mainland delivery
settings.text: Flat $100 to Vancouver, Richmond, the Tri-Cities and nearby.

settings.title: Canada-wide shipping
settings.text: Rates calculated at checkout from your postal code. Free on orders over $3,000.

settings.title: Free pickup
settings.text: Curbside at the Richmond warehouse, or through our Calgary partner.

settings.title: Try before you buy
settings.text: Free in-person and virtual demos, so you order the right unit the first time.

settings.heading: Delivery, pickup, assembly and returns.
settings.help_text: Have your order number handy and call or email the team.

settings.title: Local delivery
settings.text:
We deliver in the Lower Mainland, including Vancouver, Richmond and the Tri-Cities, for a flat rate of $100. Our team brings your new workbench or cabinet to your door so it arrives safely and quickly.

Orders over $3,000 qualify for free shipping.

settings.title: Shipping across Canada
settings.text:
Outside the Lower Mainland, rates are calculated for every delivery location in Canada and added automatically at checkout once you enter your postal code. Larger units ship on a pallet; please let us know if your address needs a lift-gate or has limited truck access.

Need a quote for a business order or a tricky location? Contact us and we'll price it for you.

settings.title: Pickup
settings.text: Free local curbside pickup is available from our Richmond, BC warehouse at Unit 142 – 11566 Eburne Way. Place your order online, then schedule your pickup time with us. In Alberta, orders can be collected through our Calgary distributor, My Tool Shop.

settings.title: Assembly and installation
settings.text:
Base units arrive assembled where shipping allows; add-ons such as hutches, side lockers and pegboards bolt on with basic hand tools. Instructions and hardware are included where applicable.

Professional assembly is available on eligible products for an additional charge. Ask us when you order.

settings.title: Returns and exchanges
settings.text:
We provide free in-person and virtual product demos so you can be sure you're choosing the right TOOSA product for your workspace before you buy. Because of this, we do not offer returns or exchanges after purchase.

We believe in the quality of our workbenches, cabinets and workstands, and we're confident they will meet your needs. Not sure which configuration is right? Book a demo first.

settings.title: Warranty
settings.text: TOOSA products come with a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Product-specific warranties may vary, particularly for specialised equipment such as air compressors; the exact terms are listed with the product.

settings.title: Damaged or incorrect items
settings.text: Inspect your delivery when it arrives. If anything is damaged in transit or not what you ordered, contact us as soon as possible with your order number and photos, and we'll sort it out.

settings.heading: Questions about delivery?
settings.lead: Tell us where you are and what you're ordering; we'll confirm the cost and timing before you commit.
